page.overview:
Who is Bazz?

When first speaks to , he will welcome him to and explain that they have been looking for a like him. He mutters to himself that seems familiar, believing that they have met a long time ago.

If speaks to a second time, he is certain that he remembers who is. However, due to the shorter lifespan of , decides to test him in order to be sure. He asks if he knows the Bigg Badd Bazz Brigade password, starting with, "Fluffy white clouds! Clear blue..." After successfully guesses the word "Zora", will be convinced that the person he is speaking to is . If confirms that he is, excitedly proclaims that he knew it. If denies this, refutes him, saying only a member of the Big Bad Bazz Brigade could know the password.

Noticing that looks the same as he did 100 years ago, asks what he has been doing. If tells him that he was sleeping, refuses to believe anyone could sleep so long. If is unable to come up with an answer, assumes he was doing something important. Either way, he repeats that is in need of the help of a , and he urges to meet with .

Once has confirmed 's identity, he will answer questions for him. When asked about , explains that he is located upstairs. He is certain that must remember him, revealing that he is the father of . When asked this question after has met with , reminds him that is the father of both and . He also reveals that things have been difficult for the since was defeated by .
